title: Flux 2 LoRA Gallery Face to Full Portrait
description: Extends a face into a full body portrait

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The URL of the cropped face image. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt describing the full portrait to generate from the face. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. If not provided, the size of the input image will be used. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale. Controls how closely the model follows the prompt.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

inputs.name: acceleration
inputs.tooltip: Acceleration level for image generation. 'regular' balances speed and quality.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed for reproducibility. Same seed with same prompt will produce same result. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enable the safety checker for the generated image. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the output image

inputs.name: lora_scale
inputs.tooltip: The strength of the face to full portrait effect.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
